# Redistributed runtime licenses

The release package dynamically links Qt 6.8.3 and the MinGW GCC runtimes. The packaged license texts are kept here for offline distribution.

- `LGPL-3.0-only.txt` and `GPL-3.0-only.txt`: from the Qt qtbase v6.8.3 source tree, https://github.com/qt/qtbase/tree/v6.8.3/LICENSES .
- `GCC-exception-3.1.txt`: GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1, from the GCC 13.1 source file https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/blob/releases/gcc-13.1.0/COPYING.RUNTIME .

Qt source: https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.8/6.8.3/submodules/qtbase-everywhere-src-6.8.3.tar.xz .
MinGW compiler source: https://gcc.gnu.org/releases.html .
Project source: https://github.com/kanostars/Rock-auto-music-player .
